description: Evaluation set for the Academic RAG QA system. Write 20-30 entries YOURSELF from your notes (questions an examiner would ask), including a few out-of-scope questions. The 3 entries below only illustrate the schema and refer to the generated sample PDFs in data/samples/.

schema.question: the question as a student would ask it
schema.subject: optional subject tag (informational)
schema.expected_source: PDF filename that contains the answer (null for out-of-scope questions)
schema.expected_pages: list of 1-based page numbers where the answer is (empty for out-of-scope)
schema.reference_answer: short correct answer written from the notes (used by the relevance judge)
schema.in_scope: true if the answer is in the material; false if the system should refuse

items.question: What is the difference between 3NF and BCNF?
items.subject: DBMS
items.reference_answer: 3NF allows X -> A when A is a prime attribute even if X is not a superkey; BCNF requires the determinant of every non-trivial FD to be a superkey, so BCNF is stricter.

items.question: Explain the TCP three-way handshake.
items.subject: CN
items.reference_answer: Client sends SYN (seq x), server replies SYN-ACK (seq y, ack x+1), client sends ACK (ack y+1); the connection is then established.
